title: Metal Resistance
desc_lfm_album: Metal Resistance (stylized as METAL RESISTANCE) is the second studio album by the Japanese metal idol group Babymetal, released on March 29, 2016. Background The album was announced in December 2015 to coincide with news of a new world tour, with the album's title confirmed in January 2016. On February 19, the band released the artwork and tracklist for the album, along with a February 25 release date for the album's lead single, "Karate". .
desc_lfm_artist: Babymetal (Japanese: ベビーメタル, Hepburn: Bebīmetaru), stylised in all caps, is a Japanese kawaii metal band formed in Tokyo in 2010. The group consists of Suzuka Nakamoto as "Su-metal" (lead vocals, dancing), Moa Kikuchi as "Moametal" (backing vocals, dancing), and Momoko Okazaki as "Momometal" (backing vocals, dancing). The band is produced by Kobametal of the talent agency Amuse Inc., and their live performances are supported by a group of session musicians known as the "Kami Band".
